title: WorldVote
tagline: web3 voting solution with attestations and account abstraction
description:
This project brings the idea of voting with the innovations of web3 for every user. A wallet is not required, yet you can do all the necessary transactions to register everything in the blockchain. 

Each vote is issues an attestation as to further proof the validity, private and public polls exist if you wanna hear the public opinion or only selected individuals
how_its_made: This project uses @thirdweb SDK to provide account abstraction and paymasters, so the user interacts with the application as seamless as possible. To verify all the transactions @blockscout is used, also to verify every smart contract. @worldid is used to verify the humaness of a person, and only if they are verified they are eligible to vote.
